governance.parent: Secretaria da Cultura, Economia e Indústria Criativas do Estado de São Paulo (management contract)

basis: The museum's page says the Associação Pinacoteca Arte e Cultura (APAC) has run it since 2006 under a management contract with the state culture secretariat; APAC's 2024 statute (art. 1 and the powers of the Conselho de Administração in art. 35) gives its private nonprofit form, the board's election of directors and approval of the annual budget.
Note 1 (operating context) of the independent auditors' report on the 31 December 2024 financial statements calls Pivô a cultural association without profit purposes, founded in 2012.

controls: approval of programme, loans or disposals by a ministry or council

basis: Sesc's published Instituição e Regulamento (September 2014, regulation last amended by Decree 6.632 of 2008): art. 4 makes Sesc an institution of private law organised and directed by the Confederação Nacional do Comércio, art. 25 has the Conselho Regional approve the work programme, budget and real-estate operations, and art. 42 treats Sesc as an employer under labour law.

governance.parent: Ministry of Communication, Culture, Arts and Tourism

basis: The report of the Council of Ministers of 6 November 2024, under the culture ministry, says a decree created the Agence burkinabè de la cinématographie et de l'audiovisuel under the general status of administrative public establishments, with its own statutes approved by a further decree, and merged the Délégation générale du FESPACO into it; the festival site shows the agency running FESPACO 2027.
The archived copy of doual'art's own about page (24 January 2025; the live page refuses requests) calls it l'association and says its permanent salaried team has 5 people.
